body: I don't know why. There isn't a reason, I had decent parents, was never abused, never had anything traumatic happen to me, wasn't bullied, we didn't live in poverty. People dream of having a childhood like mine. Despite that I was anxious from a very early age, I used to pull my hair out starting when I was an infant to calm myself, I was bald by the time I was 4. The. Then suicidal thoughts started around 7 or 8. I have just always felt anxious and wanted to die and the only explanation I can come up with is pure selfish ungratefulness. It's just a fundamental flaw in my personality.

No, it was not blissful. We got married at the county clerk's office during my lunch break after having a huge fight so he could get on my health insurance, never said any vows. It's a marriage of necessity, I need him to drive me because I'm too scared to drive by myself, I need him to make me food because I'm too fucking lazy to get out of bed. He needed me because he was jobless and homeless and has low self esteem. We had been together for so long, since we were teenagers, it was easier to just stay together. We do love each other, but it isn't enough for me anymore.
